summary: Completed testing of 2 new features: (1) Expanded Room Selection with 14 room types in 3 categories displayed as visual cards with icons, and (2) Save Materials List as PDF with room dimensions input and cost calculations. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All 14 room types properly defined in ROOM_CATEGORIES with icons (lucide-react), names, and descriptions
Each room type has corresponding STYLE_PROMPTS in backend for AI generation
All 14 room types have BASE_COSTS defined in cost_estimator.py
PDF generation uses jsPDF library (client-side) with proper branding and calculations
data-testid attributes properly implemented on all new components
Room dimensions correctly calculate floor area and wall area for material quantities
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features tested: (1) Room selection with 14 room types in 3 categories - Interior (6), Functional (4), Outdoor (4). All room cards have icons, names, descriptions. Selection highlighting works with primary color. (2) PDF feature accessible from 'Save Materials List' button below each design and from 'Save All Materials as PDF' button in Material Explorer panel. PDF modal has dimension inputs (length, width, height), calculated areas preview, and generates downloadable PDF with materials, costs, and contractor quote section.
